title: Do Black Holes Really Erase Every Secret?

segments.text: Do black holes really erase every secret?
They swallow everything, even the details of what fell in.
Hawking showed the emitted radiation depends only on mass, electric charge, and spin.
Two completely different stars can collapse into black holes with identical mass, charge, and spin.
Those black holes evaporate into indistinguishable clouds of photons.
The final radiation carries no trace of the original state.
This matches the no‑hair theorem, which says interior details are ignored.
Quantum mechanics demands information cannot vanish, so the paradox appears.
The universe seems to lose that secret
